title: Tenant runtime enforcement for business modules (phase 2 of T14, split per module)
goal: Make tenant_id effective at runtime: read scoping, write ownership, tenant-scoped route groups with registered permission routes, and tenant identity carried into background work, one module at a time, with compat-mode behaviour unchanged.

in: Per-module enforcement in the order of PLAN.md
Rollout that keeps compat mode unchanged

implementationNotes: 审查主基线 444ce8e，当前规划基线 a2d69d4a759b5df2b26aaa9d26bdc5175babe9dc；每包开工核实当前候选，先复用 #195 实现与归档证据再补缺口
本包状态 planned；命令与运行场景是后续验证计划，执行者须记录真实 cwd/时间/exitCode/skip/源码哈希
接口/权限/菜单/i18n/schema/seed/fixture/业务overlay 同步关闭；业务 migration 源文件归业务模块，装配副本由重建器生成

2026-11-25 phase 1 (schema): migration 000043 adds tenant_id to the 18 verified extension tables and rebuilds five natural unique keys tenant-first. The T01 list was wrong: biz_preflight_control is a test-only table; biz_application, obs_alert_rule, obs_alert_event, obs_notification_channel and obs_notification_log were missed.

Finding: T04 delivered schema only. No business code uses tenant.Scoper/TenantOwnerID, and cicd/filedist/cmdb/deploy/k8s still mount DataScopedGroup, so tenant_id is not yet enforced on reads or writes anywhere outside observability. Phase 2 (read scope, write owner, route-group switch with registered permission routes, async tenant identity) is not done.
acceptanceCriteria: Each module task proves, on a real MySQL, that tenant B cannot read or write tenant A's rows and that compat mode is unchanged
Background entry points keep the originating tenant across restart
Every route of a switched module has a registered permission route (fail-closed)

commands: go test with PANTHEON_TEST_DSN (needs the CI MySQL service)

humanGates: Maintainer accepted the split on 2026-11-25; each module PR still needs acceptance.
